commonTransformations.participantPseudonym: Project-specific keyed pseudonym derived from Participant.id; the key is not exported.
commonTransformations.objectPseudonyms: Project-specific keyed pseudonyms derived from operational activity, item, course, chatbot, thread, and message identifiers.
commonTransformations.dayFields: Operational timestamps coarsened to a calendar date.

asynchronous-question-responses.csv.note: One derived row per participant and element instance. Attempt-level QuestionResponseDetail rows are not included.

learning-analytics-groups.csv.note: One cohort-level row per activity. Empty metrics show a group below the example threshold, not missing participant records. The release projection must be recalculated from the currently eligible population; existing aggregate rows cannot be exported unchanged. The export contains no participant key or participant-level error details.

chat-transcripts.json.note: Pseudonymisation covers identifiers, not free text. Image payloads, provider secrets, and lifecycle attempt IDs are excluded.
